sentences: India is emerging as a major force in AI adoption and innovation, with professionals across virtually all industries finding new ways to integrate AI and automation tools into their workflows.
As Indian professionals explore the possibilities of generative AI, access to the right tools and latest models is becoming more important for users everywhere.
Adobe has met this demand by expanding the range of third-party AI models compatible with its generative AI model, Adobe Firefly.

With integrations spanning image and video creation, Adobe Firefly’s expansion to accommodate India’s most commonly used AI models, gives creative professionals greater flexibility to experiment with different models and bring their ideas to life without constantly switching between tools.

Here’s what users should know about the latest Firefly updates, from what partner models are now compatible, to how this most recent expansion of Adobe’s AI ecosystem could change the way creative work gets done.

Adobe Firefly is now compatible with OpenAI, Google, Topaz Labs, and more
After Adobe Firefly and Firefly Foundry’s latest updates, platform users can now enjoy a more dynamic output of photo, video, music, animation, and AI art generation – all within the one tool.
Adobe Firefly is now compatible with several of the latest, industry-leading AI models, including OpenAI, Google, Runway, Topaz Labs, ElevenLabs, and more.
These integrations allow creators to optimise their workflows and consistently create using multiple tools to generate a whole range of assets.
The expansion of Firefly compatibility with other AI partner models, makes Adobe Firefly more attractive to Indian professionals and creatives who utilise multiple AI tools in any given workflow.
Let’s say you want to use Firefly’s AI image generator to refine an image produced by prompting ChatGPT.

With Firefly’s seamless integration with GPT’s Image generation model, users can now easily generate multiple style variations of the original GPT-derived image prompt until they find the right style to fit their needs.

Firefly’s capacity for video generation and image to video prompting also means you can transform that original GPT-generated image into a video as well, and then polish that Firefly-derived product in Luma AI, with full cross-platform compatibility.

Simply put, with Adobe Firefly’s compatibility with other industry-leading AI partner models, you can enjoy the best AI image tool, the best AI video tool, and the best AI graphic design, audio, and art tools all at the same time and with a seamless UX.
Adobe Firefly users can now enjoy full compatibility across a variety of leading AI models.
By expanding compatibility, Firefly users can exercise greater creative control over their work across several AI models without worry of inconvenience or hiccups.

Like all of its models, Adobe Firefly’s Image Model 5 is ethically trained on public domain data and independently managed datasets, including their own stock photo, video, and audio libraries.
Developing Image Model 5 using controlled datasets has helped Adobe ensure that Firefly is “commercially safe” to use.
Adobe’s careful approach makes Firefly the safest toolkit to use for business purposes without worry about potential copyright infringement.
The convenience of full integration with other AI tools makes Firefly a natural choice for teams requiring a holistic approach for managing their generative AI work.
Integration with Firefly Foundry and Firefly Boards further adds to the convenience of establishing Adobe Firefly as a centralised hub for all things generative AI.

AI ecosystems are evolving differently in comparison to other tech ecosystems, and largely, it’s been sink or swim.
By expanding how many AI models Firefly is compatible with, Adobe is ensuring that their tools are developing at pace alongside others in the ecosystem at large.
In this way, Adobe Firefly not only can lead the way in creative output, but also keep up with every other brand’s outputs as well.
By letting users move seamlessly between different AI tools, Adobe is providing Firefly adopters greater freedom.
Choosing to use Adobe Firefly is not only a safe choice, but one that doesn’t require sacrificing efficiency by locking yourself out of using other tools.
This mindset is central to Adobe Firefly’s priorities, maintaining compatibility with other industry-leading AI models while remaining leaders within the space.
In summary, Adobe Firefly’s expanded compatibility with leading AI models offers several key advantages to creative and professional users.

Adobe differentiates Firefly from other AI models through its commitment to ethical and controlled data training.
As users gain access to third-party models, transparency around how those models work becomes increasingly important.
This cements Adobe as a safe industry leader, whose tools continue to pave the way for commercially viable creative work.

Adobe supports responsible and commercially safe AI use in three key ways:
Adobe has garnered themselves a reputation for advertising as the world’s first “commercially safe” AI.

What this essentially means is that Adobe asserts that all outputs generated within the Firefly platform are copyright-safe, in that they belong entirely to the user and can be used for business or marketing purposes without risks of copyright infringement.
Note: Adobe provides transparent information about partner models within Firefly, helping users assess their suitability for business and marketing projects.
However, commercial-use rights and protections can vary by model, so users should check the relevant terms when applicable.

Adobe states that personal user content (i.e. generated outputs, raw uploaded files, etc.) isn’t used to train Firefly nor any of Adobe’s updates to its generative AI models, subject to its applicable policies and terms.
This sets Firefly apart from other AI models that do not provide the same assurances in their frameworks.
Adobe attaches metadata called 'Content Credentials’ to all files generated using Firefly and any of its partner models.
These Content Credentials essentially help to identify how content was created or edited, supporting greater transparency around AI-generated and AI-assisted content online and in the media.
With compatibility across over 10 AI partner models, Adobe Firefly is making it easier for creatives to explore generative AI without being limited to a single model or workflow.
From generating images and videos to developing campaign concepts, Firefly’s capabilities continue to grow alongside the wider AI landscape .
For professionals in India and around the world, this expanded flexibility offers more ways to experiment, refine ideas, and develop commercially focused creative assets within one platform.
By combining access to leading partner models with tools such as Firefly Boards and a focus on responsible AI practices, Adobe is giving creators more freedom to decide how they work.
With its expanding range of compatible models, the possibilities are growing all the time.
So, really, the question isn’t “what can you create with Adobe Firefly?”.
Rather, the question is what will you create with Adobe Firefly?
